title: Flagsmith CLI config
description: Configuration for the Flagsmith CLI. Fields map one-to-one onto command-line flags and FLAGSMITH_* environment variables.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference enabling editor autocomplete and validation.

project.title: Project ID
project.description: Flagsmith project ID. Find it via `flagsmith projects list` or JSON data in the dashboard. `flagsmith config` shows the resolved project name.

organisation.title: Organisation ID
organisation.description: Optional. Used by organisation-scoped commands that have no project context (e.g. creating a project) and to preselect the organisation in `flagsmith init`. Otherwise the organisation is derived from the project.

environment.title: Default environment (client-side SDK key)
environment.description: Client-side environment key identifying the default environment for `-e`/`--environment`. Unique per environment and safe to commit: client-side keys are public by design. Also enables flag evaluation without Admin API credentials. Server-side keys (ser.*) are secrets and are rejected here: provide those via the FLAGSMITH_ENVIRONMENT_KEY environment variable instead.

apiUrl.title: API base URL
apiUrl.description: Optional. Base URL of a self-hosted Flagsmith instance (scheme + host, without /api/v1). Omit when using Flagsmith SaaS.

sdkApiUrl.title: SDK API base URL
sdkApiUrl.description: Optional. Base URL of the SDK API used for flag evaluation. Only needed when the SDK API lives on a different host than apiUrl (e.g. when using Edge Proxy). When omitted, falls back to apiUrl, otherwise to Flagsmith Edge API (https://edge.api.flagsmith.com).
